definition: the main way into a house from the street
description: On a narrow cobbled street of grey stone houses in the morning, a young man in a navy bathrobe and slippers stands in the open doorway of his house holding a steaming mug, looking shocked. A shaggy brown long-horned cow stands right beside him and snorts out a cloud of breath, and he steps back inside behind the glossy red front door with its brass knocker and fan-shaped window. A cat walks past two milk bottles on the step, a herd of cows fills the street behind, and a neighbour laughs at a window.

de.answer: Er zieht sich hinter seine Haustür zurück.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Se está retirando detrás de su puerta principal.
